changeSet.sql: WITH day_start AS ( SELECT p.id AS planning_id, d.value ->> 'id' AS day_id, min(CASE jsonb_typeof(r.value -> 'startingHour') WHEN 'string' THEN (r.value ->> 'startingHour')::timestamptz WHEN 'number' THEN to_timestamp((r.value ->> 'startingHour')::numeric) END) AS day_start, min(jsonb_typeof(r.value -> 'startingHour')) AS hour_format FROM salon_talk_planning p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p.configuration -> 'days', '[]'::jsonb)) AS d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(d.value -> 'rooms', '[]'::jsonb)) AS r GROUP BY 1, 2 ), talk_rows AS ( SELECT p.id AS planning_id, t.ordinality AS ord, t.value AS talk, COALESCE((p.configuration ->> 'intervalMinutes')::int, 30) AS interval_minutes, 0 AS preparation_minutes, CASE WHEN t.value ->> 'type' = 'WORKSHOP' THEN 60 ELSE 45 END AS duration_talk_minutes, 15 AS cleanup_minutes, ds.day_start, ds.hour_format FROM salon_talk_planning p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p.talks, '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(value, ordinality) LEFT JOIN day_start ds ON ds.planning_id = p.id AND ds.day_id = t.value ->> 'dayId' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p.talks, '[]'::jsonb)) AS existing WHERE jsonb_exists(existing, 'startingHour')) ), migrated AS ( SELECT planning_id, ord, talk || jsonb_build_object( 'preparationMinutes', preparation_minutes, 'durationTalkMinutes', duration_talk_minutes, 'cleanupMinutes', cleanup_minutes, 'durationTotalMinutes', preparation_minutes + duration_talk_minutes + cleanup_minutes) || CASE WHEN talk ->> 'dayId' IS NULL OR talk ->> 'roomId' IS NULL OR day_start IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('startingHour', NULL) ELSE jsonb_build_object('startingHour', CASE hour_format WHEN 'number' THEN to_jsonb(extract(epoch FROM ( day_start + make_interval(mins => COALESCE((talk ->> 'startSlot')::int, 0) * interval_minutes)))) ELSE to_jsonb(to_char(( day_start + make_interval(mins => COALESCE((talk ->> 'startSlot')::int, 0) * interval_minutes)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')) END) END AS talk FROM talk_rows ) UPDATE salon_talk_planning p SET talks = m.talks FROM (SELECT planning_id, jsonb_agg(talk ORDER BY ord) AS talks FROM migrated GROUP BY planning_id) m WHERE p.id = m.planning_id;
